decisions.reason: The provisioning procedure creates and maps a campaign-specific Zap but does not change the existing requirement to synchronize HubSpot lists to MeetAlfred.
The source does not mention silent leads, follow-up lists, or the deferred follow-up workflow.
Creating a campaign and updating its Zap does not change the standing MeetAlfred configuration requirement or subscription plan.
The source does not identify the new campaign as an email campaign or resume the deferred automated-email requirement.
The source does not identify the new campaign as a LinkedIn campaign or change the existing LinkedIn campaign requirement.
Duplicating and publishing a Zap does not change the candidate's Zapier subscription plan or add-on requirements.
Creating a new campaign and duplicating a Zap neither removes nor changes the requirement to preserve existing MeetAlfred campaigns and integration assets.
The source does not state that production leads were used for testing or alter the test-identity restrictions.
The campaign-provisioning procedure does not change any HubSpot lead-management properties, lists, notes, stages, or task-assignment behavior.
The duplicated Zap is unrelated to showing CRM duplicate status while viewing a LinkedIn profile.
The source does not change the requirement to connect the campaign email system to MeetAlfred and HubSpot.
The source concerns provisioning a campaign and its Zap, not synchronization of MeetAlfred reply status into HubSpot.
